description:
Shorts tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- create_shorts_preset: Save a named, reusable creative formula — aspect ratio, model, look/effect, caption style, target platform, brand kit, character, and voice 
- list_shorts_presets: List the creative presets you can use — your own plus any shared into an organization you belong to.
- update_shorts_preset: Edit a saved creative preset in place — only the fields you pass change.
- delete_shorts_preset: Delete a saved creative preset.
- apply_shorts_preset: Turn a saved creative preset into a ready-to-run payload — merged inputs (model, aspect ratio, duration, negative prompt, voice) plus the ex
- create_shorts_session: Create a durable, resumable multi-shot shorts run from a saved preset (or ad-hoc settings).
- list_shorts_sessions: List your shorts sessions — id, title, status, and shot progress — newest first.
- resume_shorts_session: Start or resume a shorts session, generating only the shots that are not already done.
- list_shorts_styles: List the style looks that create_shorts_restyle can apply to a source video.
- create_shorts_restyle: Restyle one source video (4-120 s) into styled short pieces with a look from list_shorts_styles (or your own style_image_url).

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).

name: shorts
title: Shorts
